channel.title: Vifug blog
channel.description: Practical articles on presentation software for churches and live events.

item.title: Accessible presentations: rules that help everyone
item.description: Practical rules for contrast, size, colour-blind safety, motion, language and hearing-impaired viewers, and how theme options help you apply them.

item.title: Live presentation software beyond church
item.description: How schools, conferences, studios, venues and signage setups can use live presentation software, with practical examples using Vifug.

item.title: Switching from ProPresenter or EasyWorship
item.description: A step-by-step plan for moving a church media team to new presentation software: audit songs, import, rebuild themes, and run both systems in parallel.

item.title: Planning for no-internet Sundays: offline and backups
item.description: Design your church media setup to survive a dead router or a dead laptop: offline-first habits, backups, a spare machine, and restoring in Vifug.

item.title: Why lyrics and Scripture need different themes
item.description: Why one slide look cannot serve lyrics, Scripture, sermon slides and announcements, and how to give each content type and screen its own theme in Vifug.

item.title: The Preview and Live workflow: stop on-screen mistakes
item.description: Why separating Preview from Live prevents wrong slides, typos and surprise camera shots, with a step-by-step way to run it and the mistakes it catches.

item.title: Presenting Bible verses well on screen
item.description: Practical advice on translation choice, verse chunking, references, multiple languages and pace, with an offline Bible in 31 English versions and more.

item.title: Service planning and run sheets for the media desk
item.description: How to build a service run sheet with the right order, cues, timers and announcements, and how to turn it into a plan, timer and ticker in Vifug.

item.title: Lower thirds and speaker name bars for livestreams
item.description: What lower thirds and name bars are, when to show them, how to design and time them, and how to set up both in Vifug over a camera or stream overlay.

item.title: Church presentation software vs PowerPoint

item.title: How AI auto-follow works, and what it cannot do
item.description: What speech-following for lyrics and Scripture can and cannot do, Deepgram versus on-device engines, and how to keep the operator in charge.

item.title: Training new media team volunteers in four weeks
item.description: A four-week onboarding plan for new church media volunteers, with roles, a one-page checklist, rehearsal habits and calm Sunday-morning routines.

item.title: Choosing worship backgrounds: stills and motion
item.description: How to pick still or motion backgrounds for worship slides, keep them legal and light on the computer, and keep words readable, using Vifug as the example.

item.title: How to choose presentation software: a checklist
item.description: A step-by-step checklist for choosing presentation software: team skill, hardware, offline use, streaming, import and support, with a scoring table.

item.title: Different pictures for the room and online viewers

item.title: Stage display and multiple screens for church services

item.title: How many lines of a song should go on each slide?

item.title: Setting up a projector and second screen for church
item.description: How to cable a projector, choose mirror or extend, match resolution and aspect ratio, test brightness, and assign the output screen in Vifug.

item.title: Designing lyric slides readable from the back row
item.description: Font, size, contrast, outlines, safe margins and reading distance for lyric slides, with the exact settings to use in Vifug's theme designer.

item.title: What is presentation software? Types and uses
item.description: A plain explanation of presentation software: slide tools, worship and live-production tools, and signage, and what each kind is actually good at.
